coming_up_next.summary: Organizers see where the group's availability overlaps, pick rehearsal times with warnings for missing required members, and confirm them with a location.
coming_up_next.title: Combined availability and confirming rehearsal times

recommended_steps.detail: Native date and time pickers and the layout at phone width are still yours to judge. Delete project/data first if it holds groups from before this phase.
recommended_steps.title: Run the Phase 2 demo on a phone

recommended_steps.detail: Phase 3 will ask whether members can see each other's individual availability or only the combined overlap.
recommended_steps.title: Think about availability privacy

see_for_yourself.expected: The next eight weeks list every Thursday except next week, labelled with the group's time zone.
steps: cd project && corepack pnpm run dev --host
Open a group and tap My availability
Add Thursdays 19:00 to 22:00 starting this week with no last date
Under Can't make a Thursday, tap Can't make it for next week
see_for_yourself.title: A weekly slot with one exception

see_for_yourself.expected: The Thursdays move to 19:30 and the Saturday disappears.
steps: Add a one-off Saturday 14:00 to 17:00 two weeks from now
Edit the weekly slot to 19:30 to 22:00
see_for_yourself.title: Edit and delete

see_for_yourself.expected: Each is refused with a readable message next to the field.
steps: Try an end time before the start time
see_for_yourself.title: Refusals

what_just_landed.detail: Members open My availability from their group page and add one-off times or weekly times, open-ended or with a last date, on a 30-minute grid.
what_just_landed.title: My availability

what_just_landed.detail: Each weekly time lists its next eight weeks with a Can't make it button that removes just that date.
what_just_landed.title: Can't make one week

what_just_landed.detail: Times can be changed or deleted; edits keep skipped dates that still fall on the new pattern.
what_just_landed.title: Edit and delete

what_just_landed.detail: New groups choose a time zone, defaulted from the organizer's browser; every time is entered and shown in that zone.
what_just_landed.title: One time zone per group
